analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 38.3, entering oversold territory, recovering from 34.0 five days ago. MACD histogram improving to -1.0181 but still weak. Volume ratio at 0.41, indicating contraction. Price pattern shows a Lower High relative to the 20-day range. Weekly ADX at 33.7 indicates a clear trend, but -DI (37.9) is above +DI (18.8), suggesting downward pressure. Current price $77.82 is near swing support at $77.45. Considering ATR of $3.85 (4.95% of current price), a 1.5x ATR stop loss ($5.78) would be $72.04, and a 2x ATR target ($7.70) would be $85.52. Risk/reward ratio is 1.33, below the 1.5 minimum. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
